text:
maria: Quick heads-up — while validating network policies in the private on-prem bundle I spotted keystore-proxy making an outbound flow to telemetry.example.com (34.120.23.12:443) from the sealed VLAN. that should be impossible.
raj: Which cluster/namespace and can you paste the netpol + flow snippet?
maria: cluster=priv-us-west1, ns=redwood-keystore. flow tail: 
```
DROP => default-deny applied
ALLOW egress to 10.0.3.5 (internal kms gateway) -> OK
ALLOW egress to 34.120.23.12:443 (telemetry.example.com) -> unexpected
```
olivia: oof. sec-scan flagged a metadata-fallback exfil vector earlier. paste the scan id so I can correlate.
maria: scan id: s-2026-03-21-01. sec-bot already posted automated finding.
sec-bot: [AUTO] vuln-scan s-2026-03-21-01: keystore-proxy allowed egress to external host from privileged namespace
ben: short mitigation: tighten netpol to explicit egress whitelist for redwood-keystore ns, restart pods for immediate enforcement. quick patch sketch (will open PR with proper manifest):
```
kubectl -n redwood-keystore patch networkpolicy deny-external --patch '{"spec":{"egress":[{"to":[{"ipBlock":{"cidr":"10.0.0.0/8"}}}],"policyTypes":["Egress"]}}'
```
maria: opening PR infra/k8s#8420 to: 1) add explicit egress whitelist (internal CIDRs + KMS IPs), 2) add egress-deny test to the conformance suite, 3) reduce RBAC for keystore SA (remove secrets/get, scope to certificate rotation endpoints). not flipping cloud KMS IAM yet until attestation plan is in place.
raj: For KMS we should require attestation before granting Decrypt — e.g., workload identity + signed instance token or SPIFFE ID. also enable per-call audit metadata (requester pod/serviceaccount) so decrypt events map back to runtime identity.
olivia: audit plan: filebeat on nodes shipping signed keystore+audit logs to internal SIEM over mTLS; immutable on-disk audit files. for air-gapped customers write signed bundles to WORM and ingest via offline collector appliance.
ben: vuln triage checklist: 
- rotate keystore keys in staging
- patch netpol to block 0.0.0.0/0 egress from redwood-keystore ns
- implement KMS attestation gating + least-priv IAM
- enable decrypt-level audit with requester metadata
- run exploit PoC in staging to verify mitigations
maria: IR note: if we see external decrypts, immediately cut egress for the namespace, rotate keys, and follow runbook INC-priv-2026-03-21. I've drafted the isolated runbook at /runbooks/priv-keystore-isolation.md (internal).
raj: Owners: @olivia can you own the PR review and canary deploy? @ben can you run key rotation in staging and capture the audit evidence? I'll coordinate with Security for post-mortem and customer comms if needed.
olivia: I'll take PR review + deploy. plan: canary -> monitor 15m -> full rollout. targeting 16:30 PT today.
ben: Starting key rotation in staging now; creating ENGOPS-321 to track artifacts and will attach to the PR.
maria: adding tests to PR: egress-negative tests, decrypt-audit-asserts, attestation-failure fallback checks. tagging to avoid drift. :thumbsup:
olivia: ack
raj: ack
